reason: I run a big shop and my POS mostly works. A new company could close and take my data, and I don't want to retrain 15 techs and the front desk on something unproven.
objection: Who are you? If you shut down in two years, what happens to my client list, my tickets and my payroll history? Switching is a risk to a shop this size.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three big salons I know, with 11 or more techs, running it for over a year, plus a written promise that I can export all my data any time.
